product_metadata.title: Lamatar1 Mt Everest Himalayan Region Cedar Rope, from Kathmandu Nepal, Eco-Friendly, Used for Aromatic Ambiance, Healing, Purification, Made from Pure Cedar Wood, Natural & Safe, 45 Ropes in a Bundle
features: NATURAL: Pure cedar wood from the Himalayan area of Nepal is used to make the cedar rope incense. The incense is completely safe and natural, and it fills the air with an earthy, woody, and refreshing fragrance. Made by rural Nepalese women.

USED FOR: The wood from an evergreen tree with a very fragrant wood is used to make this cedar rope incense. It has been utilised for spiritual protection, curing, and purification as well as for harmony, peace, and success. Cedar is frequently utilised in aromatherapy.

ECO-FRIENDLY: Rope incense is made using a special technique that involves stuffing eco-friendly lokta paper with natural herbs and twisting it. Each rope incense is skilfully hand-rolled. These rope incense-making techniques have been utilised for generations in the Himalayas.

BENEFITS: Improved memory, youth, luck, the removal of depression, stress reduction, and many other benefits. Burning is used to purify, stimulate or strengthen psychic abilities, attract love, and gain spiritual wisdom.

HOW TO USE: To burn the rope incense, lit the end of the braided rope and blow out the flame and allow it to burn well up to the top of the rope. The incense can be burnt on a flat burner plate or put into the incense burner like normal incense.

details.Material: Cedarwood, Cedar Oil and Lokta Paper
